sources: [S1] TSE (Türk Standartları Enstitüsü) — TS ISO 22400-2, TS EN 13306 (ISO member)
[S2] ENOSAD — Industrial Automation Association of Turkey
[S3] siskon.com.tr, akillifabrika.org, eratilmis.com — Turkish OEE resources
[S4] Wikiversity Turkish-English false friends (aktüel, fabrika confirmed)
[S5] terms.json — Turkish translations analyzed for consistency validation

falseFriends.performance: 'Performans' accepted for OEE component; 'verimlilik' (efficiency) is more native — distinguish carefully
falseFriends.productivity: Use 'verimlilik' (native), not 'prodüktivite' (French loanword) in formal contexts
falseFriends.operator: 'Operatör' is accepted loanword; 'işçi' (worker) is too informal
falseFriends.control: 'Kontrol' (French loanword) dominates in manufacturing; 'denetleme' is more native
falseFriends.station: Use 'iş istasyonu' for workstation, not 'istasyon' alone (transport station)
falseFriends.setup: Use 'hazırlık süresi' (setup time) or 'kalıp değişimi' (die change), not 'kurulum' (software installation)
falseFriends.billion: Use 'milyar' (10^9), not 'trilyon' — Turkish uses short scale like English

grammarNotes.agglutinative: Suffixes modify meaning: 'vardiya' → 'vardiyada' (in the shift), 'vardiyaların' (of the shifts)
grammarNotes.vowelHarmony: Back vowels (a, ı, o, u) vs front vowels (e, i, ö, ü). Violations immediately apparent.
grammarNotes.subjectObjectVerb: SOV word order. Verb comes at end in sentences.
grammarNotes.compoundSpacing: Turkish compounds include spaces: 'çevrim süresi' (cycle time), NOT 'çevrimsüresi'.
grammarNotes.compoundPluralModifiers: In Turkish izafet (possessive compound) constructions, the modifier stays UNMARKED while the head noun takes plural and possessive suffixes. 'hız kaybı nedenleri' (speed loss [unmarked] + reasons-its [pl+poss]) is correctly formed. No compound pluralization issue — correct by izafet rules.

industryContext.oeeTerminology: OEE is standard. Full Turkish term: 'Toplam Ekipman Etkinliği' (TEE) — TEE not standardized, OEE preferred.
industryContext.leanTpmAdoption: Yalın Enstitü (lean.org.tr) is key driver of lean/OEE terminology. TAYSAD automotive suppliers drive adoption.
industryContext.dominantSectors: Automotive (Ford Otosan, Toyota Turkey, Hyundai Assan, TOFAS ~10% industrial production), white goods (Arçelik), textiles

commonMistakes: Using 'verimlilik' and 'performans' interchangeably — 'performans' is OEE component, 'verimlilik' broader
Forgetting compound word spacing: 'çevrim süresi' not 'çevrimsüresi'
notes: OEE is used; formal 'siz'. Agglutinative with vowel harmony. Text expansion ~20-30%. TEE exists but not standardized. P95 expansion 1.60x.
